question: The Union Finance Minister in Budget 2025-26 announced to set up _____ Atal Tinkering Labs in Government schools in next 5 years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**50,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Finance Minister in the **Budget 2025-26** announced the establishment of **50,000 Atal Tinkering Labs** (ATLs) in government schools across India over the next five years.
 
• **Atal Tinkering Labs** are part of the flagship initiative under the **Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)**, launched by the **NITI Aayog**.
 
• The main aim of establishing these labs is to foster a culture of **innovation and entrepreneurship** among students by equipping schools with state-of-the-art infrastructure to allow hands-on learning.
 
• The initiative targets promoting **STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) education** in schools and emphasizes critical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills among young learners.
 
• These labs are expected to encourage students to work on **real-world problems** and develop prototype solutions using innovative technologies like **3D printing, IoT (Internet of Things), Robotics, and Artificial Intelligence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Atal Innovation Mission (AIM):**

 
 
• Launched by the **Government of India**, AIM is a flagship initiative to promote a culture of **innovation and entrepreneurship** across the country.
 
• The mission includes multiple components such as **Atal Tinkering Labs**, **Atal Incubation Centers**, and **ARISE** (Applied Research and Innovation for Small Enterprises).
 
• AIM supports the creation of an ecosystem conducive to **scientific exploration** and promotes collaboration between academia, industry, and startups.
 
 
 
• **Features of Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs):**
 
 
• Each ATL is equipped with cutting-edge tools like **3D printers, robotics kits, microcontrollers, IoT devices, and sensors**.
 
• Students are encouraged to ideate and implement projects that address **real-world challenges** like water conservation, renewable energy, and health solutions.
 
• The labs provide a platform for students from **Class 6 to Class 12** to explore and develop their innovative potential.
 
 
 
• **Impact of ATLs:**
 
 
• Encourages the development of **entrepreneurial skills** among students at a young age.
 
• Promotes interdisciplinary learning by integrating **science, technology, and practical application**.
 
• Helps in building a future-ready workforce equipped with **21st-century skills**.
 
• Fosters grassroots innovation and builds a culture of **problem-solving and critical thinking** in schools.
 
 
 
• **Key Statistics:**
 
 
• As of **2023**, over **10,000 Atal Tinkering Labs** have already been established in schools across India, benefiting thousands of students.
 
• The **target of 50,000 labs** aims to significantly expand the reach of this initiative, especially in rural and underprivileged areas.
 
• Each ATL receives a grant of up to **INR 20 lakhs** to set up the infrastructure and manage operational costs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Eligibility:** ATLs are set up in schools managed by government, local bodies, or private trusts, provided they meet the eligibility criteria set by the **AIM**.
 
• **Training and Mentorship:** The initiative includes training programs for teachers and students and connects schools with industry mentors for guidance.
 
• **Global Competitiveness:** ATLs aim to prepare Indian students to compete at **international innovation challenges** and hackathons.
 
• **Alignment with NEP 2020:** The initiative aligns with the **National Education Policy 2020**, which emphasizes experiential learning and skill development.
